payload.name: Capture-explicit-new-activity-starts
payload.description: During candidate extraction, when a message explicitly states that the speaker started or began learning a new activity, skill, or hobby, capture the start as a distinct event with its temporal context.
content: During extraction, when a message contains an explicit start marker (e.g., 'started learning', 'began', 'just started') for a new activity, skill, or hobby, create a distinct event candidate recording the start, the activity, and the temporal anchor from the message/session timestamp.
Keep the initiation event separate from any state candidate about enjoyment or current practice; do not merge the start time into a general state note.
Stop after the single explicit start—do not infer starts without a marker and do not expand to every activity mentioned.

solves: Explicit 'started learning'/'began' statements lose their initiation time during extraction, leaving only an enjoyment/practice state, so later 'when did it start' questions fail. Apply when a message names a new activity, skill, or hobby with an explicit start marker: record the start as a distinct event with the message's temporal anchor. Skip when the message only implies ongoing practice or enjoyment.
